name: hey-my-buddy
description: Host-directed local dsh work with explicit Git workspaces, assistance and continuation, shared model evaluations and a private React/Vite console over the transactional Python/C-Two blackboard.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate work to local dsh via the Buddy CLI.
interface.longDescription: Delegate scoped repository work through the uv-managed Buddy CLI. Explicit Git snapshots and Host capabilities govern assistance, continuation and final artifact acceptance. A private React/Vite console shows tasks and bounded shared model evaluations. Independent workers own execution and shutdown; Python and C-Two retain durable task state. Legacy one-shot adapters remain available. Background follow-up uses an explicit App heartbeat; no MCP server or peer delegation is required.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a bounded task to my local dsh.
